notes: Brown asphalt shingle, the roof the art direction names. The meso band at 90 cells is the granule -- an asphalt shingle is stone chips bonded to felt, about 1 mm, and reading it as smooth is what makes a roof look like painted card. Colours are 33 codes of channel spread apart, comfortably coarser than the 16-step quantiser, so the posterize rule in tests/test_posterize_palette.py does not bite.
